### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Keep the Update agents dialog's height while its rows load](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3208) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — On a skill's Used by tab, the `Update agents` dialog keeps its height while it checks which agents you can update, instead of shrinking row by row. `Update all skills to latest` shows placeholder rows as tall as the loaded ones.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.17.6...v3.17.7
